data.title: RBI hikes repo rate by 25 bps to curb inflation
data.description: The Reserve Bank of India raised the repo rate, pressuring banks' loan growth and rate-sensitive sectors like real estate and auto.
data.snippet: HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank shares fell after the announcement while analysts expect higher EMIs to dampen housing demand.

data.title: Crude oil surges past $95 as OPEC+ extends output cuts
data.description: Higher crude prices raise input costs for airlines and paint makers while benefiting upstream oil producers.
data.snippet: Reliance Industries and ONGC gained while IndiGo slipped on fuel cost worries.

data.title: India retail inflation rises to 6.2% in September, above RBI target
data.description: Food and fuel prices pushed consumer inflation higher, squeezing margins of packaged-goods makers and raising odds of tighter policy.
data.snippet: FMCG stocks such as Hindustan Unilever and Nestle India slid as input costs climbed.

data.title: RBI keeps repo rate unchanged, signals pause after earlier hike
data.description: Central bank holds rates steady, easing pressure on banks and real estate after last week's tightening.
data.snippet: Banking stocks rebounded and realty indices rose as markets priced in an end to the hiking cycle.

data.title: Crude oil slides 4% as demand worries and rising US inventories weigh
data.description: Lower crude prices cut fuel costs for airlines and paint makers but weigh on upstream oil producers.
data.snippet: IndiGo and Asian Paints advanced while ONGC and Reliance Industries edged lower.

data.title: Infosys beats estimates as Q2 profit jumps 9%; raises FY27 guidance
data.description: Strong deal wins and stable margins lifted quarterly earnings, boosting sentiment across the IT services sector.
data.snippet: TCS and Wipro shares rose in sympathy.
